NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 7, 2:42 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 21.5 DraftKings points for $8,800, at Washington. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (20.4, $9,300) and CeeDee Lamb (19.3, $8,300) are next.

Antonio Williams returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.69 projected points per $1,000 at $4,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 7, 2:42 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 9

Puka Nacua, LAR at WAS ($8,800)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.5 DraftKings points at $8,800, the 5th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.1 points clear of Jaxon Smith-Njigba. The model gives him 10.8 targets on 30.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.45 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 33 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.4 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 46.4, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Washington, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA vs ARI ($9,300)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects 2nd at the position with 20.4 DraftKings points at $9,300. The model gives him 9.3 targets on 26.5 routes. The salary works out to 2.20 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 33 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 20.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 44.7, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 39.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL at IND ($8,300)

CeeDee Lamb projects 3rd at the position with 19.3 DraftKings points at $8,300. The model gives him 10.4 targets on 32.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.33 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 33 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 19.3 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 43.5, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Antonio Williams, WAS vs LAR ($4,100)

Antonio Williams projects for 11.0 DraftKings points at $4,100, which works out to 2.69 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 33 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 5.7 targets on 21.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 11.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 25.7, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Washington is a 4.5-point underdog at home against the Rams, with an implied team total of 21.5 in a game totaled at 47.5.
